hooks: Apple's iMac M6 brings a faster CPU and AI engine.
The iMac now runs AI models on‑device up to five times faster.
Apple says the M6 delivers up to 5× faster on‑device AI performance than the M4.
what_happened: Apple unveiled the iMac M6 with a 12‑core CPU, up to 5× faster AI than M4, and up to 18× performance over the Intel iMac.
why_it_matters: It lets users run on‑device AI and demanding apps much faster, improving everyday productivity and creative workflows.
